blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Fresh off his golden run at the Asian Games, two-time Olympic gold medalist Carlos Yulo announced Monday that he is engaged to longtime partner Chloe San Jose. In a social media post, Yulo revealed that he proposed last December, sharing details of the lavish setup in Tagaytay where he got down on one knee and asked San Jose to marry him. “9 months ago… She said ‘Yes,’” Yulo said. “And all I can say and all I can feel, is that I am truly blessed.
